profile_summary: A curious, detail-oriented user with strong interests in technology, photography, history, gaming, and food. They often compare options and ask for concrete evidence, but their preferred travel pace, destinations, lodging, and budget are not established. Treat travel ideas as possibilities rather than assumed preferences.

personality_traits.description: Often asks follow-up questions across subjects such as how things work, local food, technology, history, and current events.
Frequently requests comparisons, practical details, price checks, and verification before forming a view.
Has requested reading schedules, study plans, and stepwise practice. This may make structured travel information useful, but does not establish a preference for tightly scheduled vacations.

personality_traits.trait: Open to exploring specific new options
personality_traits.description: Has asked about unfamiliar equipment, activities, and cuisines. Questions alone do not confirm enjoyment or willingness to include them in a trip.

recommendation_guidelines: Use the San Jose / Bay Area as a broad home-region reference when local or departure context is useful; do not assume a specific airport or preferred route.
Consider aviation, motorsports, technology, history, and distinctive food experiences as possible recommendation themes.
When comparing options, provide concrete differences such as price range, travel time, logistics, and what makes each option distinctive.
Treat hiking, nightlife, luxury stays, theme parks, beaches, and other unverified preferences as exploratory options rather than established likes.
Do not infer that owning or considering camera, gaming, or vehicle equipment means the user wants to bring or use it on every trip.
Ask about pace, budget, lodging, transportation, companions, and dates when those details materially affect a trip recommendation.
